svg.title: Lapis Atlas BRAND-L3 synthetic launcher and splash preflight
svg.desc: Inspectable synthetic home-screen, sixteen labelled adaptive icon comparisons, 108 dp safe-zone geometry and API 29 through 31 plus static splash concepts. Not an emulator or device screenshot.

svg.text: FICTIONAL WALLPAPER + FICTIONAL APPS • NOT A DEVICE CAPTURE
Atlas cell: 144 px in this 3× illustration = 48 dp
Each icon shown at 48 dp concept scale. Mark geometry stays unchanged.
Themed-on tint is a concept, not observed Android output.
Monochrome with themed off = isolated asset-layer preview.
03 Exact mark geometry / protected safe zone
108 dp adaptive icon source · mark-only scale 0.77 about (54,54), including stroke
Chevron stroke = 2.74 dp · sphere r = 5.13 dp
04 Synthetic static cold start / theme handoff
The Lapis splash ground is deliberately identical in light and dark system contexts.
Scope: design documentation only. No app resources, emulator screenshots, installed theme or device proof.
